questions.q: 8. Three candidates were participating in an election. The person at third place got 20% of the total votes while the difference between the votes of the winner and the first runner up was 20% of the total votes. If the difference between the votes of the first runner up and the second runner up was 37,000, how many votes did the winner receive?
questions.s:
8.(b)
Let total votes = 100 units
2nd runner up got = 20 units
The difference between the votes of the winner and the first runner up is 20% of the total votes.
Let x be the winner , y be first runner up and z be second runner up.
x - y = z  
⇒ x = y + z
x + y + z = 100 units
⇒ 2x = 100  
⇒ x = 50
x = 50 , y = 30 and z = 20
10 units → 37,000
Then, 50 units  →  1,85,000
Hence, the winner got 1,85,000 votes.

questions_hin.q_hi: 1. A ने B से 30% अधिक निवेश किया। B ने C से 40% कम निवेश किया, जिसने कि ₹8,000 का निवेश किया। उन सभी द्वारा एक साथ निवेश की गई कुल राशि (₹ में) है:
questions_hin.s_hi:
1.(d)

माना C द्वारा निवेश की गई राशि = 100

तो, B द्वारा निवेश की गई राशि =  100 का 60% = 60 और

A द्वारा निवेश की गई राशि = 60 का 130% = 78

A, B और C द्वारा निवेश की गई कुल राशि =  78 + 60 + 100 = 238

प्रश्न के अनुसार,

₹8,000, C द्वारा निवेश की गई राशि से मेल खाती है जो कि 100 है,

उन सभी द्वारा निवेश की गई कुल राशि = 238 × 8000100 = ₹19,040

A leader gets 35% votes but 480 less than the winning leader. How many votes does the losing leader get?

एक नेता को 35% मत प्राप्त हुए लेकिन जीतने वाले नेता से 480 मत कम प्राप्त हुए। हारने वाले नेता को कितने मत प्राप्त हुए हैं?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Percentage difference between the votes of winning and losing leader = 65% - 35% = 30%

Given,

30% = 480

35% = 480 * 35/30 = 560
